preserved_non_gateway.boundary: It remains a static public experience that returns to universal entry and is not a lane output.

review_gated.boundary: Do not publish a derivative or collect responses until reuse scope and privacy review are confirmed.
No external or protected destination becomes a gateway output without its documented activation gate.
It is not a public-content source or automatic publication mechanism.
It permits only narrow owner-selected review and cannot scan devices, collect material automatically, or create a public route.

invariants: Only tracked first-party static Table and Counter pages are gateway outputs.
No identity, account, analytics, payment, submission, or server-side access capability is created by this manifest.
External destinations remain blocked until their ownership, reachability, intended use, privacy, and launch approval are verified.
Review-gated sources require human review and never publish automatically.
